source_claims.claim: All eight exact detection requests contain active accuracy_reporting_v1 and use _CanonicalCOCOEvaluator, which imports pycocotools COCO/COCOeval. Legacy proxy is retained but is not selected by these policy-bearing requests. The service passes metric_gate_config to the factory without discarding the reporting policy.

Canonical evaluator creates COCOeval(..., bbox) without overriding maxDets; optimized_coco_v1 keeps its last maxDets value. Current pycocotools defaults [1,10,100], so reported AP uses 100. Producer top300 is distinct from evaluator maxDets100.
Canonical evaluator applies no new score threshold; request decoder/NMS contracts record confidence0.25, NMS IoU0.45, max detections300. These are prediction-generation parameters.

Canonical evaluation uses library IoU/recall grids. Current defaults are IoU0.50:0.05:0.95 and recall0:0.01:1.00. Primary AP averages valid precision over all IoUs, all recall levels and categories; guardrails use slices0 and5 (AP50/AP75).

Canonical evaluator categories are sorted integer class_id values present in supplied ground truth. Per-class COCO evaluation uses library default useCats1; projected task records use the model COCO80 zero-based label space.

Ground-truth area is supplied if present, otherwise bounding-box area. Canonical AP reads all-area precision index0. Optimized mode keeps only library all-area range; current all-area range[0,1e10], small[0,1024], medium[1024,9216], large[9216,1e10].

Canonical evaluator forwards iscrowd and ignore to COCO, defaulting each to0. Policy-bearing runner projection retains original iscrowd and area, but does not explicitly project original annotation ignore. COCO bbox crowd/ignore matching is delegated to pycocotools. Retained legacy proxy disregards crowd/ignore/area and has no evaluator detection cap, but is not the policy-selected evaluator.

Exact requests bind decoder/NMS implementation_runner_sha256 and adapter_id. Adjacent retained benchmark_suite.py may have a different hash, and cannot establish historical runner implementation identity. Per-UID request metadata and mismatch receipts preserve this distinction.
Classification evaluator computes top1/top5 from paired records and image multiplicities. COCO maxDets/IoU/area/crowd/NMS parameters are not applicable to classification UIDs.
